title: Year-End Leave Carry-Over Rules — Payroll Bulletin
content: Acme Corp Payroll Department confirms that unused annual leave may be carried over to the following calendar year up to a maximum of 5 days. This limit is set by the payroll system and will be enforced automatically at year-end processing. Any unused leave in excess of 5 days will be converted to a one-time cash payout at the employee's base daily rate. This cash payout will be included in the December payroll run. Employees should plan their leave accordingly and speak to their manager before November 30 if they anticipate having more than 5 days of unused leave.
